candidates.title: Cadet Drafter, Roads & Highways
candidates.content_text: Part time. Roads & Highways team on the Gold Coast, road and transport infrastructure across Queensland. Assist preparation of design and production drawings under supervision; drawings and documentation for road and transport projects; construction-level documentation; drawing checks, print and issue procedures; document control. About you: currently enrolled in an Advanced Diploma or Associate Degree relevant to civil engineering, drafting or design; interest in civil infrastructure, roads and transport; willingness to learn CAD with emphasis on Autodesk; full Australian working rights. Apply via Apply Now; do not forward resumes directly to SMEC employees.
candidates.apply_instructions: Workday Apply Now only; SMEC asks that resumes not be sent directly to employees
